name: אֱמֹרִי
summary: The Amorites, counted among Canaan’s descendants, whose guilt was not yet complete in Abram’s day; the singular names the people collectively or one of them, as Mamre the Amorite. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The singular gentilic stands between the Jebusite and the Girgashite in the genealogy of Canaan’s descendants.
Mamre is called הָאֱמֹרִי, identifying one man as an Amorite.
The singular הָאֱמֹרִי designates the Amorites attacked at Hazazon-tamar, where הַיֹּשֵׁב says they lived.
In עֲוֹן הָאֱמֹרִי, the singular gentilic identifies the Amorite people whose guilt is still incomplete.

note: Moved from the former word entry `2eaemoriy` (old root key אמרי, the noun’s own consonants). A tie to אמר “say” is not shown.
